physical_hypothesis.causal_change: Use the pinned residual-aware RMSNorm plus dynamic-per-token E4M3 primitive to absorb only a distinct residual-add prologue before the unchanged gate-up scaled-MM.
physical_hypothesis.predicted_movement: Remove zero or one pre-GEMM launch and zero to 344064 BF16 bytes per selected call while leaving gate-up weight bytes, useful FLOPs, scaled-MM inputs, and dispatcher unchanged.
physical_hypothesis.falsifier: The generated stock boundary already has the same effective launch/dataflow, any required numerical or structural guard fails, or the production-weighted projection is below 0.002 seconds per request.

arms.stock: torch.compile of the exact pinned RMSNorm.forward_static plus QuantFP8.forward_native expressions, followed by the unchanged cutlass_scaled_mm consumer
arms.candidate: vllm._custom_ops.rms_norm_dynamic_per_token_quant with residual argument, followed by the identical cutlass_scaled_mm consumer
arms.first_call_synchronization: Synchronize and persist a completion marker after each arm's first untimed exact-consumer call; exclude these synchronizations from timing.
arms.timing: Profiler-off warm CUDA events with 8 warmups and 40 samples per arm in one process.

correctness.finite_outside_envelope: Persist the numerical negative and still collect the paired timing when outputs are finite and structurally valid.
correctness.nonfinite_or_structural_failure: Stop before timing and classify as decision-bearing incorrect.

mutable_execution_scope.permitted_consumer_amendment: Hash-bind the smallest control-flow amendment that records finite out-of-envelope correctness and continues into the unchanged paired timing. Do not change operands, operations, shapes, seeds, tolerances, timing count, projection, or decision threshold.
permitted_repairs: the bounded finite-negative timing control-flow amendment
forbidden_mutations: model, revision, runtime image, vLLM source identity, shapes, layouts, dtypes, scales, producer or consumer semantics
correctness tolerances or 0.002 seconds/request promotion threshold

researcher_execution.container_rule: Use sudo -n docker from the first execution-equivalent remote command and the exact pinned image; stage only the hash-bound runner/owner packet.
researcher_execution.first_gpu_call: The first exact stock and candidate consumer calls inside the bound program are the discovery smoke. Repair ordinary compile, API, import, path, permission, or serialization defects inside the continuous claim and proceed directly to the pair.
researcher_execution.durable_owner: Record detached-owner PID, Linux start ticks, absolute owner state, artifact root, forward progress marker, repair ID, and deadline atomically in STATUS.json.active_session.

terminal_dispositions.positive: If all correctness guards pass and projected saving is at least 0.002 seconds/request, retain the claim and wake the director for narrow runtime promotion.
terminal_dispositions.decision_bearing_negative: If the result is structurally interpretable but incorrect or projects below 0.002 seconds/request, persist both arms and timing when permitted, then release the unoccupied bench available by 2026-07-28T20:58:00Z.
terminal_dispositions.incomplete_or_uninterpretable: Retain the continuous claim with a live repair-capable owner and fresh repair ID while the closest measured repair, terminal, and safe release fit before 2026-07-28T20:58:00Z. Do not release merely because the initial owner failed.
terminal_dispositions.deadline_or_unsafe: At the absolute disposition fence, or if the guest becomes unsafe or unreachable, persist the diagnostic and release to maintenance for director handling.
